title: Lightning lab 1
description: Short, timed, mixed tasks across every domain.
scenario: Short, timed, mixed tasks across every domain. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Upgrade
tasks.instructions: Upgrade the control plane to the next minor version and drain/uncordon correctly.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Extract
tasks.instructions: Print the names of all Deployments in namespace admin2406 with their image and ready replicas, sorted by name, to a file.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Fix
tasks.instructions: A kubeconfig at /root/CKA/admin.kubeconfig is broken. Fix it.
